 Recap: Top moments, stats and scores from NBA Mexico City Game 2026
 Nikola Jokić and the Nuggets defeat the Pacers 114-102 in Mexico City.
 Jerry Jiang, for NBA.com
 Updated on November 8, 2026 12:44 AM Nikola Jokić and the Denver Nuggets defeat the Indiana Pacers in Mexico City.
 What we know about NBA Mexico City Game 2026
 The Denver Nuggets and the Indiana Pacers will take part in the 35th NBA Mexico Game (5 p.m. ET NBA TV & League Pass )
 It will be the 35th NBA game played in Mexico – this will be the 16th regular-season game, along with 19 preseason games – as the country has hosted the most NBA games outside of the United States and Canada.
 Jokić on triple-double watch: the 3-time Kia MVP recorded his 201st career triple-double last Wednesday and needs nine more to pass all-time leader Russell Westbrook
 For more on the matchup, including game details, history and viewing information, check out our NBA Mexico City Game 2026: Everything to know 
 6 other games in the slate for today 
 7:34 PM / NOV. 7
 Nuggets Get The Win In Mexico City
 Nuggets 114, Pacers 102. Final . 
 The Denver Nuggets improve to 5-3, while the Pacers fall to 3-7 with the Nuggets’ 114-102 win on Saturday in Mexico City.  
 There was just one lead change, but the Nuggets lead wire-to-wire for the win.  
 Jokić stuffed the stat sheet per usual with 19 points, 13 rebounds and 8 assists. Cameron Johnson was a spark for the Nuggets, providing them with 18 points. Denver shot 45.8% from the field and 28.6% from distance.  
 The Pacers bench outscored the Nuggets 52-43. Pascal Siakam had 23 points and Larry Nance Jr. dropped 5 3-pointers, but it wasn’t enough. 
 7:29 PM / NOV. 7
 Nuggets In Control
 Nuggets 110, Pacers 99. 2:16, 4Q . 
 Every time it seems the Pacers have pushed the Nuggets’ lead to single digits, Denver responds.  
 This time, it’s Murray who pushes the Nuggets’ lead to 11.
 JAMAL MURRAY GOES THE FULL 94 FEET FOR THE SCORE 😱
 Nuggets secure the W in the NBA Mexico City Game 2026! pic.twitter.com/tTCc86Dc7M 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 8, 2026 
 7:14 PM / NOV. 7
 13K Career Points For Siakam
 Nuggets 104, Pacers 95. 6:33, 4Q .  
 Siakam gets past his defender for the layup and achieves his 13,001st point of his career.  
 Pacers are on a 13-5 run over the last 2:22. They’ve shot 67% from the field in the second half and now drill 14 3-pointers as a team.  
 The Pacers had cut the lead to 7, but a nice find from Jamal Murray to Spencer Jones pushes the lead to 9.  
 7:04 PM / NOV. 7
 How Obi Toppin?!
 Nuggets 90, 78. End 3Q . 
 Sometimes comebacks need miracle shots, like these.  
 This wild 3-pointer by Obi Toppin gives him 7 points on the night.  
 OBI TOPPIN, HOW? 
 He banks in the WILD contested three for the @Pacers !
 📺 NBA Mexico City Game 2026 on NBA TV pic.twitter.com/UR41ZwLjIM 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 8, 2026 
 6:57 PM / NOV. 7
 Pacers Hold The Momentum With Run
 Nuggets 90, Pacers 78. End 3Q . 
 The Pacers have trimmed the Nuggets’ lead down to as much as 10, but the Nuggets hold the advantage to 12 as we head into the final frame.  
 Ivica Zubac quietly has a double-double with 10 points and 12 rebounds. The Pacers hold the momentum.  
 Jokić is flirting with a triple-double as he now has 19 points, 10 rebounds and 8 assists. Cameron Johnson matches Larry Nance Jr.’s 15 points.  
 6:48 PM / NOV. 7
 No Leads Are Safe. Here Come The Pacers
 Nuggets 81, Pacers 67. 4:34, 3Q . 
 Aaron Nesmith has spurred the Pacers’ rally with his 8 points, all coming in the third quarter.  
 They’re on an 18-5 run over the last 3:36. 
 Larry Nance Jr. also has 5 3-pointers, which ties a career best.
 6:41 PM / NOV. 7
 Pacers Storming Back
 Nuggets 74, Pacers 58. 6:40, 3Q . 
 The Pacers are storming back with a run.  
 A 27-point lead is down to 16 thanks to Pascal Siakam’s 14 points. 
 6:30 PM / NOV. 7
 Siakam’s Milestone
 Nuggets 70, Pacers 49. 9:17, 3Q .  
 Pascal Siakam is playing in his 700th career game on Saturday.  
 That’s a pretty incredible feat for someone who started their career in the G League.  
 Siakam is playing in his fourth season with the Pacers after spending the first eight years with the Raptors, where he won a championship in 2019.  
 He’s trying to rally the Pacers back into the game in Mexico City.  
 6:04 PM / NOV. 7
 Nuggets Are Rolling
 Nuggets 64, Pacers 41. End 1H . 
 The Nuggets are on a 30-9 run over the last nine minutes of game play.  
 They earn a 23-point lead at the half. The Nuggets are getting contributions from the entire team, with Marvin Bagley III’s 8 points, Cameron Johnson’s 9 points and Jamal Murray’s 7 points. 
 5:42 PM / NOV. 7
 Danilo Gallinari, Neně, Greivis Vásquez, Horacio Llamas Honored
 Nuggets 27, Pacers 19. End 1Q . 
 Former NBA players Neně, Greivis Vásquez and Horacio Llamas get recognized in between quarters.  
 Nenê played 10 seasons with the Nuggets, where he averaged 12.4 ppg. He was drafted with the No. 7 overall pick in 2002.  
 Vásquez played for five different teams. He was drafted in 2010 with the No. 28 pick. He appeared in all 82 games with the Toronto Raptors in the 2014-15 season.  
 Horacio Llamas played two seasons with the Phoenix Suns from 1996-97 and 1997-98. 
 Danilo Galinari, who recently retired from basketball in 2025, was also in attendance.
 NBA LEGENDS in Mexico City 🤩
 🍿 Nuggets/Pacers
📺 NBA Mexico City Game 2026 on NBA TV pic.twitter.com/VBZlxYJNYs 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 8, 2026 
 5:38 PM / NOV. 7
 Nuggets Are Up Early
 Nuggets 27, Pacers 19. End 1Q . 
 Jokić is already doing Jokić things. He’s up to 10 points, 6 rebounds, and 3 assists.  
 The Nuggets are shooting 40.7% from the field. 
 5:30 PM / NOV. 7
 Oubre Says No
 Nuggets 23, Pacers 13. 2:43, 1Q. 
 Kelly Oubre Jr. sprints the distance of the court and denies Christian Braun’s dunk attempt.  
 Check out this full-out effort from Oubre.
 THIS EFFORT BY KELLY OUBRE JR. 😤
 Gets back in transition… AND SWATS IT!
 Watch the NBA Mexico City Game 2026 on NBA TV. pic.twitter.com/qtScuqff8Q 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 7, 2026 
 Despite the highlight from the Pacers, the Nuggets are on a 23-8 run over the last 7:20. 
 5:18 PM / NOV. 7
 We’re Off And Running In Mexico City
 Nuggets 12, Pacers 7. 7:52, 1Q.   
 Pascal Siakam gets things started with a 3-pointer in transition.  
 Then, Nikola Jokić finds a cutting Aaron Gordon for the slam.  
 Jokić is already getting MVP chants in Mexico City. 
 5:13 PM / NOV. 7
 Gordon, Walker Address The Crowd
 Nuggets vs. Pacers. Pregame   
 We thought Pascal Siakam would address the crowd, but Jarace Walker stepped up and spoke to them.  
 The Pacers’ bench was hyped. 
 The Nuggets had Aaron Gordon, who spoke in Spanish.  
 Aaron Gordon and Jarace Walker BOTH address the crowd in Spanish 👏
 The NBA Mexico City Game 2026 is LIVE on NBA TV! pic.twitter.com/w4wcBzwg7d 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 7, 2026 
 5:10 PM / NOV. 7
 Pregame Moments In Mexico City
 Nuggets vs. Pacers. Pregame   
 Nikola Jokić and the Denver Nuggets arrive for pregame action along with Pascal Siakam and the Indiana Pacers.  
 Among the pregame festivities, DeMar DeRozan had a special moment to connect with his family. 
 DeMar DeRozan and his son share a special moment before today's action begins in Mexico City 🥹
 🆚 Nuggets/Pacers
📺 5pm/et, NBA TV pic.twitter.com/UAJl7KmQix 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 7, 2026 
 The Nuggets’ assistants are getting the Joker warmed up with his signature-style passes.  
 The Nuggets help the Joker warm up in style with Jokić-esque passes 🤩
 🆚 Denver/Indiana
📺 5pm/et, NBA TV pic.twitter.com/guYw7pQnw6 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 7, 2026 
5:04 PM / NOV. 7 
 Throwback To This Iconic Moment
 Nuggets vs. Pacers. Pregame   
 Remember this iconic moment from 2019?  
 Luka Dončić, who speaks Spanish fluently, addressed the crowd with a lot to say.  
 Blake Griffin, on the other hand, not so much.
 Mexico City Game 2019:
 Luka had plenty to say in Spanish to address the crowd… and Blake Griffin? "Hola Mexico!" 😂
 Pacers and Nuggets battle in this season's Mexico City Game at 5pm/et on NBA TV. pic.twitter.com/BkaN5EGIBC 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 7, 2026 
2:27 PM / NOV. 6 
 Pacers’ official photo
 3, 2, 1… 📸 
 ¡La foto oficial de los @Pacers en la #NBAenMéxico 2026! 🇲🇽💛 pic.twitter.com/qskPKI4jgy 
 — NBA MÉXICO (@NBAMEX) November 6, 2026
